description: Defines the Time class and TimeAsLocal class for handling date and time operations, including conversions, formatting, and parsing in different formats. Contains constants, constructors, operators, and utility methods for time manipulation.

classes.name: Time
classes.description: Represents a point in time with methods for parsing, formatting, and time arithmetic, supporting both POSIX and Windows systems.

classes.name: TimeAsLocal
classes.description: Wraps a Time object to handle local time conversions and operations.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Parses a string into a Time object, supporting multiple date formats.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the Time object to a string in RFC1123 format.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds milliseconds to the Time object.

methods.name: Sub
methods.description: Subtracts milliseconds from the Time object.
